lines.text: Kalpana kijiye... ek aisa yoddha, jo sirf teen teeron se poori sena ka ant kar sakta tha!
Uska naam tha Barbarik, Bheem ka pota aur Ghatotkach ka putra.
Katha ke anusaar, uske paas teen divya baan the aur usne apni maa ko vachan diya tha ki woh hamesha yuddh mein haarne wale paksh ka saath dega.
Jab woh Kurukshetra pahuncha, toh Shri Krishna ne Brahmin ka vesh dharan karke uski pariksha li.
Krishna ne peepal ke ped ke saare patton ko ek teer se bhedne ki chunauti di.
Barbarik ne teer chalaya... aur teer ne har patte ko bhed diya.
Yahan tak ki Krishna ke pair ke neeche chhipa patta bhi!
Krishna samajh gaye ki agar Barbarik yuddh mein utra, toh uska paksh badalne ka vachan yuddh ka parinaam kabhi tay nahi hone dega.
Tab Krishna ne usse sheesh daan maanga.
Barbarik ne saharsh apna sheesh daan kar diya aur poore Mahabharat yuddh ko dekhne ka vardaan maanga.
Isi tyaag ke kaaran unhein Kaliyug mein Khatu Shyam ke naam se pooja jaata hai.
Aisi hi ansuni kathaon ke liye follow karein NEXORA!
